why_card3_lower_explanation.order_preserving_check: Isotonic regression with tie-breaker is strictly monotonic (Spearman rho = 1.0000). PR-AUC cannot improve without changing ranks.
why_card3_lower_explanation.adjusted_parameters: Blend weight w shifted from 0.03 to 0.33 based on 5% window, plus isotonic probability curve.
why_card3_lower_explanation.sample_noise_diagnosis: The 5% adaptation window contained only 13 fraud cases out of 30,028 transactions (0.043% fraud rate). Overfitting this tiny sample hurt generalisation on the remaining 95%.
